parameters.formDescription: Upload a Storeleads Domains table export CSV. Supersoniq pulls decision-makers at those domains into a Contacts build table in the client's ClayRoots base. Targeting defaults overshoot on purpose; narrow only if you mean to.

values.placeholder: appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — from the Hub Clients table
Names the build table — e.g. Shopify DTC 100k+ US

values.fieldLabel: Seniority levels (default net pre-ticked; untick to narrow)
Target departments (tick to narrow; ALL = every department)

values.placeholder: Supersoniq contacts pulled per domain — e.g. 5
tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — leave empty to create a new table
Optional label for this build — written onto every row

nodes.name: Strip Immutable
nodes.notes: Removes Build Date and Run ID from the payload. Build Date is a computed CREATED_TIME() field; writing it 422s and previously re-stamped existing rows on every append. Run ID dropped by Operator decision 2026-08-09.

nodes.name: Overflow Compute
nodes.notes: Retains the actual list of domains that returned zero Supersoniq contacts (set difference: Build SQ Requests minus SQ Guard contact domains), enriched from Parse Domains._cmap. Emits one item per contactless domain.

nodes.name: Has Overflow?
nodes.notes: Skip when empty: zero contactless domains writes nothing and goes straight to Build Log.

nodes.name: Find Reports Folder
nodes.notes: Inline Drive resolution, no resolver sub-workflow. Lists folders named Reports directly under the client driveMainFolderID.

nodes.name: Find Overflow Folder
nodes.notes: Lists folders named Leads Overflow directly under Reports.

nodes.name: Resolve Overflow Folder
nodes.notes: Drive name search is a partial match, so pick the exact folder names here.

nodes.name: Need Overflow Folder?
nodes.notes: True when Reports exists but Leads Overflow does not, so it must be created.

nodes.name: Create Overflow Folder
nodes.notes: Creates Leads Overflow under Reports when absent.

nodes.name: Overflow Folder
nodes.notes: Finalises the destination folder id from the found or created folder. Never throws; records a warning for Build Log instead.

nodes.name: Overflow Rows
nodes.notes: Re-emits the retained contactless rows so convertToFile receives one item per row (the Drive lookups above collapse the stream to a single item).

nodes.name: Overflow CSV

options.fileName: ={{ new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) }} - {{ $('Contacts Table Guard').first().json.tableName }} - Domains without contacts.csv

nodes.notes: One real binary CSV, one row per contactless domain.

nodes.name: Upload Overflow CSV

parameters.name: ={{ new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) }} - {{ $('Contacts Table Guard').first().json.tableName }} - Domains without contacts.csv

nodes.notes: Writes into the client Reports/Leads Overflow folder. Never throws: contacts are already in Airtable by this point, so failure is surfaced in Build Log instead of killing the run.

nodes.name: Overflow Result
nodes.notes: Captures the Drive URL on success or the failure reason, for Build Log to announce either way.

global.overflowError: Leads Overflow report not written: could not resolve the Reports folder in the client Drive (check driveMainFolderID on the client record).
